labels.O: page opens a new piece (display title, usually + byline/epigraph/Introduction; body does not continue prior prose)
labels.C: page continues a piece already under way (running head then resumed prose, footnotes, or mid-piece heading)
labels.F: front matter (cover, masthead, TOC, editorial board, blank) - scored as non-opening

_meta.sampling: stratified: "candidate"=pages the domain rule would emit at any back-off 0/1/2; "random"=uniform random pages. seed 20260807.
_meta.labeller: LLM (Claude), single pass, blind to looks_like_article_opening output; rubric fixed before reading.
_meta.known_limitation: All 32 openings fall in the candidate stratum; the 48 random pages contain none. Recall is therefore measured only over openings the rules already propose, NOT over all true openings in the corpus.
